sections.title: Welcome, Dear One
content: Welcome to your Inner Child Healing Journal. By opening this page, you've taken a courageous step toward healing.
Within you lives a child who still carries joy and wounds. This journal is a safe space to meet, listen to, and nurture that precious part of you.
Over the next 30 evenings, you'll explore patterns, release emotions, and learn to respond to yourself with the compassion you always deserved.
This journey is not about perfection. Some evenings will feel light, others may bring tears. All of it is welcome. Simply show up with honesty and gentleness.
Your inner child has been waiting for you.
With warmth and belief in you

sections.title: How to Use This Journal
content: • Date pages as you go—no pressure
• If overwhelmed, pause and use resources on the last page

sections.title: Meet Your Inner Child
sections.subtitle: Guided Visualization
prompts:
Find a comfortable position. Close your eyes. Take three deep breaths.

Imagine a peaceful place—you feel safe here. In the distance, you notice a child approaching. This is you at a younger age.

Notice what they're wearing, their expression, their energy. They've been waiting to meet you.

You smile gently and say, "I'm here now. I see you."

What does your inner child want to tell you? Listen in silence. When ready, open your eyes.

sections.title: Day 2 of 30
sections.subtitle: EFT Tapping for Safety
prompts:
SETUP (Karate Chop - say 3x):
"Even though I carry fear from childhood, I deeply accept myself"

TAP EACH POINT 5-7 TIMES:
• Eyebrow: "This old fear..."
• Side Eye: "I was so small..."
• Under Eye: "I didn't feel safe..."
• Under Nose: "But I'm safe now..."
• Chin: "I choose peace..."
• Collarbone: "I am protected..."
• Under Arm: "I release this fear..."
• Top Head: "I am safe as I sleep..."
affirmations: I am safe as I rest and heal

sections.title: Disclaimer & Resources
content: This journal is for personal growth only. It is not a substitute for professional therapy.
If you experience overwhelming emotions or severe distress, contact a mental health professional immediately.
For personal use only. No reproduction without permission. Healing varies for each individual. Use at your own pace.
